conditions: scope: the bare board's copper and each I2C pin's Ci; part bodies, solder and terminations above the pads are not included
laminate and solder mask relative permittivity at most 5.4 (the IPC-4101 FR-4 maximum, specified at 1 MHz; IPC-4101 is not held, so a condition (OSH Park states FR408HR 3.61 at 1 GHz, nominal))
finished copper at most 70 um thick; finished board from 1.25 mm to 1.851 mm thick
each dielectric at least its declared minimum: F.Cu to In1.Cu 0.179 mm, In1.Cu to In2.Cu 0.891 mm, In2.Cu to B.Cu 0.179 mm
zone fill keeps the board's clearance (the DRC gate refills and judges it)
every I2C pin not counted at a declared value at most UM10204's Ci of 10 pF; no multiplexer or switch on the line
neighbouring nets are static while the line rises

on SCK and MOSI, each device pin not counted at a declared value at its part's cited maximum pin capacitance (parts table); the MCU's own pin drives the line and is not counted (DS12117 Table 149's C is the external load)

beyond the board, each connector pin on a line adds the capacitance its specification declares for the mated contact, the cable and the remote pins, as declared with its source (the line's `offboard`); nothing here measures it

U7 (BMP581): each of its pins on a bounded line counted at 10000 fF, a value the specification declares, not a maximum the datasheet prints; the bound holds only under its condition: each of U7's pins on SDA and SCL at most UM10204's Ci of 10 pF, the I2C specification its interface follows; Bosch prints no pin capacitance, so the bound holds only if the part meets that limit (source: Bosch BST-BMP581-DS004-13 v1.13: no pin capacitance in Tables 4, 5, 6, 17 (pp. 10-13, 31), I2C per NXP UM10204 (p. 33); UM10204 rev. 7.0 Table 10, p. 43: Ci 10 pF maximum)

U5 (ICM42688P): each of its pins on a bounded line counted at 10000 fF, a value the specification declares, not a maximum the datasheet prints; the bound holds only under its condition: each of U5's pins on SCK and MOSI at most TDK's typical C_I of < 10 pF; the datasheet prints no maximum, so the bound holds only if the part's pins do not exceed that typical (source: TDK InvenSense DS-000347 v1.9, 3.3.2 Table 4, p. 14: C_I < 10 pF for FSYNC, SCLK, SDI and CS in the TYP column, MIN and MAX empty (AET-WO-4220 D10))
`TP1` is a test pad on `I2C_SDA`: a probe clipped to it is an off-board load outside this bound, so a measured edge is compared with the bound plus the probe's own capacitance
`TP2` is a test pad on `I2C_SCL`: a probe clipped to it is an off-board load outside this bound, so a measured edge is compared with the bound plus the probe's own capacitance
`TP3` is a test pad on `EXT_SDA`: a probe clipped to it is an off-board load outside this bound, so a measured edge is compared with the bound plus the probe's own capacitance
`TP4` is a test pad on `EXT_SCL`: a probe clipped to it is an off-board load outside this bound, so a measured edge is compared with the bound plus the probe's own capacitance

copper only: the MCU's OSC_IN and OSC_OUT pins are not counted, because DS12117 Rev 10 states their capacitance only as CIO 5 pF typical, with no minimum or maximum (Table 49 p. 137, rev Y; Table 146 p. 241, rev V); the crystal's C0 is its own and each load capacitor is CL1 or CL2 itself, so neither is counted; each net's bound holds its mutual capacitance to the other oscillator net, which sits across the crystal

U10: its junction is screened, not guaranteed: 1170 mW of loss (declared: SNVSAN3F p. 27, Figure 9-7, typical at TA 25 C: 90 % on the 36 V curve at 2 A; P_loss = 5.237 V x 2 A x (1/0.90 - 1) = 1164 mW, rounded up) at θJA 28.0 °C/W, the figure's point at 20 cm² for the 20.82 cm² per joined layer measured on the drawn board (typical and for illustration only: a four-layer board with 2 oz outer and 1 oz inner copper, the area being the copper on each layer; TI LMR33630 datasheet SNVSAN3F F (November 2020), p. 25, Figure 9-3, typical RthetaJA versus copper area, four-layer board, HSOIC (DDA); read from the plot, each point rounded up to 0.5 C/W, sha256 3b0920a4e56a0b3f5f214a6317d3c06cff6e541e5054024adc31c30acc50c04a), is 117760 m°C on a 85 °C board, 7240 mK under 125 °C; the efficiency figure is typical at its own ambient

U11: its junction is screened, not guaranteed: 570 mW of loss (declared: SNVSAN3F p. 27, Figure 9-8, typical at TA 25 C: 82 % on the 36 V curve at 0.750 A (82.81 % read from its vectors, AET-WO-4411 (c1)); P_loss = 3.417 V x 750 mA x (1/0.82 - 1) = 563 mW, rounded up) at θJA 36.0 °C/W, the figure's point at 10 cm² for the 13.10 cm² per joined layer measured on the drawn board (typical and for illustration only: a four-layer board with 2 oz outer and 1 oz inner copper, the area being the copper on each layer; TI LMR33630 datasheet SNVSAN3F F (November 2020), p. 25, Figure 9-3, typical RthetaJA versus copper area, four-layer board, HSOIC (DDA); read from the plot, each point rounded up to 0.5 C/W, sha256 3b0920a4e56a0b3f5f214a6317d3c06cff6e541e5054024adc31c30acc50c04a), is 105520 m°C on a 85 °C board, 19480 mK under 125 °C; the efficiency figure is typical at its own ambient

U13: its junction is screened, not guaranteed: 490 mW of loss (declared: SNVSAW1E p. 26, Figure 9-8, typical at TA 25 C: 78 % on the 36 V curve at 0.505 A (79.09 % read from its vectors, AET-WO-4411 (c1)); P_loss = 3.417 V x 505 mA x (1/0.78 - 1) = 487 mW, rounded up) at θJA 36.0 °C/W, the figure's point at 10 cm² for the 13.26 cm² per joined layer measured on the drawn board (typical and for illustration only: a four-layer board with 2 oz outer and 1 oz inner copper, the area being the copper on each layer; TI LMR33620 datasheet SNVSAW1E E (November 2020), p. 24, 9.2.2.11, Figure 9-3, typical RthetaJA versus copper area, four-layer board, HSOIC (DDA); read from the plot vectors (6.4 to 58.1 cm2), each point rounded up to 0.5 C/W, sha256 865af73e62240338821cc0915dae0eeabec94f4602e0e7cc5fb1c1d49d3daf2b), is 102640 m°C on a 85 °C board, 22360 mK under 125 °C; the efficiency figure is typical at its own ambient

conditions: supply: R is a certified upper bound (Thomson's principle) on a subset of the net's copper: every flux-carrying cell lies wholly inside copper the gate reads; copper left out only raises it

supply: every hole anywhere within +-0.051 mm per axis of its pad (OSH Park 4-layer, docs.oshpark.com/services/four-layer/, read 2026-11-24, Drill Specifications: Drill Positional Tolerance Max: 2mil (0.0508mm), rounded up)

supply: every finished hole from 0.064 mm under to 0.064 mm over its drawn size (OSH Park 4-layer, docs.oshpark.com/services/four-layer/, read 2026-11-24, Drill Specifications: Drill Size tolerance Max: +/- 2.5mil (0.0635mm), rounded up / OSH Park 4-layer, docs.oshpark.com/services/four-layer/, read 2026-11-24, Drill Specifications: Drill Size tolerance Max: +/- 2.5mil (0.0635mm), rounded up), lined by at least the declared plating minimum
supply: every track at 0.8 of its drawn width (a declared condition: OSH Park publishes no track-width tolerance; 20 % is declared)
supply: pads and via pads at their drawn size: no pad etch tolerance is cited
supply: each terminal pad an equipotential: the current enters and leaves through the whole pad
supply: the source is where the regulator's current enters the domain (a buck's inductor pad); at DC it is the net's highest potential, so the bound covers the regulator's sense point too

supply: the return is the regulator's own ground pin; every other current in the ground copper (each other regulated domain's load at its consumers' ground pads, each other battery-fed regulator's input current at its own ground pin) is charged at most its current times the lesser of the load's largest return bound and the largest bound from its entry pads to that pin (the maximum principle, AET-WO-4310 (3)); where it leaves the copper only lowers the load's return
supply: the load's VDD and VSS pins are tied inside it, so the worst supply pin and the worst return pin bound its drop [inferred]
supply: copper resistivity IACS x (1 + 0.00393 x (T - 20)) x 1.181 (IPC-MF-150F 3.8.1.2's foil maximum, applied to plated copper as a stated condition), at the declared copper temperature maximum
supply: plane fill at least the outline less 0.625 mm and each knockout's measured 0.2025 mm clearance and 0.125 mm min-thickness opening (KiCad 10.0.7, measured)
supplies.limit_source: AET-WO-4300k D6 (ruled): VDD_3V3's solved minimum less this stays above TLV803S's VIT- max plus its typical hysteresis, 3030 mV
supplies.note: the bound is within 1.5x of the limit: the gate's 62.5 um pitch sets part of this margin, and a finer pitch is the known remedy
